findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that both the gender-neutral customer bathrooms (located near the deli and the front service area) do not have covered trash cans. All toilet rooms used by females must have a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Ensure that bathrooms have covered trash cans by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
Multiple cans stored on the roller rack and offered for sale to consumers are observed to have severe dents along the upper and lower seams of the cans. Cans with compromised seals present a risk of botulism to consumers. Ensure that cans with dents are not permitted to be stocked in and offered for sale. Any cans on the racks in the consumer area are assumed to be for sale unless otherwise marked. Inspector discussed best practice with person-in-charger regarding receipt of cans from suppliers including the rejection of damaged cans from the supplier at delivery and not at the time of stocking product. A follow-up has been issued for 01/03/2023 to check the condition of canned goods in the facility.

3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
The display coolers do not have hanging/stand thermometers at this time. Digital displays in the coolers along the east wall are not functioning at this time. The purpose of hanging/stand thermometers is to provide a means for staff to easily and quickly check temperatures at the foods being cold held. Built-in- digital readouts are prone to failure. Without additional calibrated thermometers failure cannot easily and quickly be recognized and the digital readout cannot be verified. Ensure that hanging/stand thermometers are available in all cold holding units throughout the facility. 

4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector pointed out several ceiling tile in the store which are water damaged with some minor mold present and bowing. The tile must be replaced. Ensure that ceiling tile are in good repair during the next routine inspection. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a significant amount of mold in the far southwest corner of the customer service area of the facility to the right of the large display freezers. Additionally, hard-to-reach areas underneath some of the shelving units has a significant amount of soil accumulating. Ensure that the facility is cleaned often enough, especially hard-to-reach areas, that accumulations of residue/debris do not occur. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed water and canned food to be on floor. Ensure food is properly stored. 
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed frost build up on reach-in cooler. Defrost and maintain freezers to provide, smooth, cleanable surfaces.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Observed apple cider labeled "Keep Refrigerated" stored in the produce cooler at 46 F. Cooler has an abient air temperature of 33-46 F (depending on shelving area). Cider was moved to a different cooler to correct the violation. All foods labeled "Keep Refrigerated" are considered potentially hazardous. All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at the appropriate cold holding temperature (41 F or below). Employee states that produce cooler temperature will be lowered in the future.750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Ceiling tile in the meat cutting and service area up front with acoustic tile. WHEN REMODELED:: Provide smooth and easily cleanable tile.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed light shields missing from the back room --in the produce section-- the freezer section. Provide covers and end caps or shatterproof bulbs for lights.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed a bottle of windex sitting on a prep table in the front area. (Corrected) Removed and put under the sink.
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
